# Matteo Giorgetti

> Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence student at IE University, building native applications, reusable simulation tools and robotics software. AI/ML internship experience at Focoos AI and research experience at IE CyPhy Life, with projects spanning backend systems, computer vision and on-device AI.

This is Matteo Giorgetti's public portfolio. The Markdown resources below provide the same public profile and case-study facts in a format suitable for assistants, search and recruiting research. Follow the project-specific contribution and limitation sections when describing the work; distinguish individual work, team contributions, prototypes and reported evaluations. The pages are public and accessible directly by URL.

## Profile

- [Profile and resume](https://mgiorgetti.com/profile.md): Education, experience, skills, community work, contact details and the complete project directory.
- [Portfolio website](https://mgiorgetti.com/): Human-readable portfolio.
- [Resume](https://mgiorgetti.com/resume.html): Human-readable resume and downloadable PDF.

## Projects

- [Noty](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/noty.md): Notes that stay attached to your Mac windows. 2026; macOS application.
- [PaddockJS](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/paddockjs.md): A reusable racing simulation for browsers and headless experiments. 2026; Open-source package.
- [Dream2Detect](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/dream2detect.md): Learning package-damage assessment from synthetic images. 2026; Research study.
- [Who’s On Repeat](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/whos-on-repeat.md): A multiplayer music game with shared rooms and an offline demo. 2026; Course project.
- [Ghostyper](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/ghostyper.md): Prepared text typed with custom pace, pauses and corrections. 2026; macOS application.
- [ClipClop](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/clipclop.md): Share text and images between a Mac and Android phone. 2025–2026; Working prototype.
- [VIGIL](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/vigil.md): Robot fleet monitoring, remote terminals and guided recovery. 2026; Lab platform.
- [VictorIA](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/victoria.md): A robot arm that reads a board and plays Connect Four. 2025; Robotics prototype.
- [Neural Noir](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/neural-noir.md): A detective game with generated cases and suspect dialogue. 2024; Game prototype.
- [MattyFlow](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/mattyflow.md): Local dictation and optional rewriting into the current app. 2026; macOS prototype.
- [Dr Sorriso Donations](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/dottor-sorriso.md): Match bank transfers to donors and record donations. 2023–2025; Internal automation.
- [Project Unity](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/project-unity.md): One keyboard and mouse across macOS and Windows. 2026; Systems prototype.
- [MOSAIC](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/mosaic-swarm.md): Robot fleet coordination and spatial debugging through shared telemetry. 2025–2026; Lab platform prototype.
- [Core Conflict](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/core-conflict.md): Agents generate and test new mechanics for a multiplayer game. 2025–2026; Game prototype.
- [ContextKey](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/contextkey.md): Cursor-side autocomplete using a model running on your Mac. 2026; Experimental prototype.
- [HoloVinyl](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/holovinyl.md): Objects select music; hand gestures control playback. 2025; Computer vision prototype.
- [TCGNET](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/tcgnet.md): A card collection marketplace with transactional inventory. 2026; Course project.
- [ReminderZ & Project Loom](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/reminderz.md): Experiments in organizing messages and visual Python programming. 2025; Desktop prototypes.
- [Learning Rules](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/pead-learning-demos.md): Interactive experiments in learning, PCA and forgetting. 2026; ML demonstrations.
- [Evolve Project](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/evolve.md): An agent that writes and loads tools during a task. 2025; Agent experiment.
- [Clash Royale in Python](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/algorithms-game.md): A strategy game with pathfinding and custom data structures. 2025; Course project.
- [Sparse SVD Recommender](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/matrices-recommender.md): Explore movie recommendations through matrix reconstruction. 2026; Interactive demonstration.
- [Budget Buddy](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/budget-buddy.md): A budget assistant using spending history and savings goals. 2024; Hackathon prototype.
- [Tech Roulette Website](https://mgiorgetti.com/projects/gdg-event-website.md): An event website for the IE GDG community hackathon. 2026; Community website.
